_meta.description: Amazon Associates and FTC requirements checked against this site. 'status' is the site's compliance state as built. Every row links to the official source.

rules.requirement: State 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' clearly and prominently on the site.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure bar on every page and beside each affiliate link.
rules.verified_quote: Associates Program Operating Agreement, Section 5, page dated 'Updated: October 15, 2025': “You must clearly and prominently state the following … on your Site: ‘As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.’”

rules.requirement: Show prices and availability only if Amazon serves the link, or the data comes from Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No Amazon prices are published. Flag F-02.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API…”

rules.requirement: Do not display Amazon customer reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators API / PA API.
rules.site_implementation: No star ratings or review counts are published. Flag F-02.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 3(t): “You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API…”

rules.requirement: Every Special Link must include the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter.
rules.site_implementation: User-supplied short links are used as given. The tag does not appear in the resolved URLs. Flag F-03.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “you must include your Associates ID or ‘tag’ (appearing as XXXXX-##…) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.”

rules.requirement: Do not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
rules.source_ref: Participation Requirements, Section 3(w); Commission Income Statement, Section 2(g)
rules.site_implementation: The links use link.amazon, Amazon's own short domain, and are labelled as Amazon links. Flag F-04.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 3(w): “You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.”

rules.requirement: Do not include Amazon trademarks in domain names, subdomains or tags.
rules.source_ref: Program Policies, Participation Requirements — suitability list, item (g)
rules.site_implementation: Site domain is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4, which contains no Amazon mark.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 3(g): “You will not … include any trademark of Amazon or its affiliates … in any domain name, subdomain name, in any ‘tag’ or Associates ID…” (quoted from the Suitability section text carrying the same prohibition)
rules.reverified: Re-read 2026-11-14: the trademark-in-domain-name prohibition appears in the Participation Requirements suitability list on the Policies page (sub-item (g) of that list), not in section 3(g). Reference corrected; the rule itself stands.

rules.requirement: Do not buy paid search advertisements on keywords that include Amazon trademarks.
rules.source_ref: Commission Income Statement, Section 2(c); Participation Requirements, Section 3(f)
rules.site_implementation: No paid advertising is connected to this site.

rules.requirement: Do not assign sub-tags to individual end users.
rules.site_implementation: No per-user tracking or sub-tags are used.

rules.requirement: Do not offer incentives for using Special Links, and do not place Special Links in customer reviews or Amazon content.
rules.site_implementation: No incentives or rewards are offered; no links are placed on Amazon.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 3(g): “You will not offer any person or entity any consideration, reward, or incentive … for using Special Links.” Section 3(p): “You will not include any Special Links in any content that you place on an Amazon Site…”

rules.requirement: Do not display price-comparison data without showing both the lowest new and the lowest used price on Amazon.
rules.site_implementation: No prices are displayed, so no comparison is shown.

rules.requirement: Do not collect, use or store product listings, descriptions or prices beyond the license; do not use data mining or robots.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. Only identifiers and a few spec fields are kept. Flag F-11.

rules.requirement: Do not use AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Planned AI content automation is NOT built. Flag F-12.

rules.requirement: Disclose a material connection clearly, placed with the endorsement, in simple language that is hard to miss.
rules.source_ref: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers, 'How to Disclose'
rules.site_implementation: The Associates disclosure sentence is shown on every page, including next to each affiliate link.
rules.verified_quote: FTC, Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers (page dated November 2019): “Place it so it’s hard to miss. The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself.”

rules.requirement: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near each affiliate link, not hidden on another page.
rules.source_ref: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
rules.site_implementation: The disclosure sentence appears directly under each 'Open Amazon link' button, in the same card or row.
rules.verified_quote: Associates Central help, ‘Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?’: “To comply with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) regulations, your link-level disclosure must be: 1. Clear. … 2. Conspicuous. It should be placed near any affiliate link or product review in a location that customers will notice easily.”

rules.requirement: Commission income is paid on Qualifying Revenue, which excludes shipping, gift-wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees and bad debt.
rules.site_implementation: Applies to any future earnings model. No earnings are calculated, because the category rate is unverified (F-01).
rules.verified_quote: Commission Income Statement, Section 1: Qualifying Purchases occur when “a customer clicks through a Special Link on your Site to an Amazon Site” and, within the session, the purchase conditions listed there are met.

rules.requirement: A Qualifying Purchase requires a Special Link click, a 24-hour session and an order within 89 days of the click (for cart purchases), and excludes search-engine-displayed and redirecting links.
rules.site_implementation: Links are direct, with no redirect or intermediate page. Search-engine display is not controlled by this site.
rules.verified_quote: Commission Income Statement, Section 1(b): a Session ends on the first of “24 hours elapse from that click”, an order for a Product, or a click through another Associate’s Special Link; Section 1(c)(i) allows completing a cart order “no later than 89 days after their initial click-through”.

rules.requirement: Do not use Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology without Amazon's prior written approval.
rules.status: Applies to the AI platform goal
rules.site_implementation: No model is trained or fine-tuned on Amazon-derived content. The AI content pipeline in the platform blueprint is gated on written approval. Flags F-12 and F-19.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 5: “You will not, without … express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.”

rules.requirement: Do not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or Amazon's policies, promotions or prices.
rules.site_implementation: Every marketing sentence in the content drafts is tied to the verified listing title or category path; anything else is left out and listed under 'Cannot claim'. F-13.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.”

rules.requirement: Do not describe an experience with a product you have not tried, and do not make claims that need proof you do not have.
rules.site_implementation: Drafts contain no first-person testing language and no performance, health or durability claims. scripts/verify.py fails the build if a testing claim appears.
rules.verified_quote: FTC, Disclosures 101: “You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried.” and “You can’t make up claims about a product that would require proof the advertiser doesn’t have…”

rules.requirement: Remove mentions of limited-time promotions from the Site as soon as the promotion ends on the Amazon Site.
rules.site_implementation: No discount, deal or promotion text is published, so there is nothing to expire. Any future campaign needs a removal step. Flag F-20.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “You must remove from your Site any links and related references to limited time promotions as soon as that promotion on the relevant Amazon Site ends.”

rules.requirement: Do not put price tracking or price alerting functionality on the Site, unless Amazon agrees otherwise.
rules.site_implementation: The pricing-analysis feature the brief asks for is limited to on-page fields and excludes any tracker, alert or historical price chart. Flag F-18.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 3(y): “Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.”

rules.requirement: When a Special Link points at a page with a Product list, the Site must carry additional original content relevant to that link.
rules.site_implementation: Category pages carry original research notes and verification tables, not only lists of links. Product lists here link to Products, not to search or department pages.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(b): “Special Links must link to Products … When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link.”

rules.requirement: Special Links may be displayed only after you have applied to and been accepted in the Associates Program; sub-tags may not be tied to individual end users.
rules.site_implementation: No Associates account or tag has been confirmed in this environment, so the marketing drafts are held as drafts and not published as commercial links. Flag F-21.
rules.verified_quote: Participation Requirements, Section 2(a): “After you have applied to the Associates Program, you are permitted to display Special Links on your Site.” Section 2(b): “Under no circumstances may you associate any sub-tag … with a specific end user of your Site.”

rules.requirement: Do not use Amazon's name or trademarks in meta tags or hidden text.
rules.source_ref: Amazon Conditions of Use, 'License and Access'
rules.site_implementation: Page meta descriptions mention Amazon only as a plain descriptive reference in the page copy; no hidden text, keyword stuffing or invisible meta content is used, and no Amazon mark appears in the domain.
rules.verified_quote: Conditions of Use, License and Access: “You may not use any meta tags or any other ‘hidden text’ utilizing Amazon’s name or trademarks without the express written consent of Amazon.”
rules.reverified: Re-read and confirmed verbatim, 2026-11-14 (this pass; page dated 'Last updated: August 14, 2026')
